runnethUseOptions.use_when_relevant: Use this whenever the user's request touches this area.
runnethUseOptions.only_when_asked: Use this only when the user asks about or reports this issue.
runnethUseOptions.status_page_only: Visible to CSMs, product, and operators, but not injected into Runneth by default.

notices.summary: Routine automation is temporarily paused during the refactor.
notices.impact: New scheduled, recurring, monitored, reminder, post-later, or background-upkeep work should not be presented as live reliable automation.
notices.workaround: Save the routine plan with cadence, trigger, task, workspace scope, and delivery target, then do the immediate one-time work where possible.
notices.statusPageGuidance: CSMs should treat new routine setup as paused. Save the routine plan and do immediate one-time work where possible.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks to create, set up, schedule, monitor, remind, notify, post later, repeat, keep something updated, or run background upkeep.
notices.runnethGuidance: Lead with the constructive boundary, offer a future routine plan, and avoid saying anything is scheduled until creation actually succeeds.
notices.supportGuidance: Capture cadence, trigger, task, workspace scope, and delivery destination so the plan can be turned on later.

notices.summary: Older Slack installs may need reconnect to use the narrower permission scope.
notices.impact: Some workspaces connected Slack before Runneth's Slack app moved to the narrower permission scope. Those older installs may still show or retain the wider grant until Slack is removed and reconnected through Runneth; newly connected orgs already use the narrower scope.
notices.workaround: Use Runneth's own Slack removal and reconnect flow: ask Runneth to remove Slack, then start a new conversation and ask Runneth to connect Slack again. Do not uninstall the app directly from Slack.
notices.statusPageGuidance: Keep Slack as a standalone native OAuth card. This is permission/reconnect guidance for older installs, not a current outage for new Slack connections.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks about Slack permissions, Slack security review, Slack reconnect, Slack reinstall, or replacing an older Slack install with the narrower scope.
notices.runnethGuidance: Explain that new Slack connections already use the narrower scope, while older workspaces may need a Runneth-managed reconnect to pick it up. Route through Runneth's integration removal and reconnect flow. Do not tell customers to uninstall directly from Slack, because that can leave the Runneth web setup widget or reinstall path unable to reconnect cleanly.
notices.supportGuidance: Confirm whether the org is a new install or an older Slack install. If it is older, tell the customer to remove and reconnect Slack through Runneth rather than uninstalling from Slack directly.

notices.impact: Runneth cannot read file uploads on Slack. Web uploads are fine.
notices.workaround: Current advice: start a new Slack conversation instead of continuing an existing thread. Start the chat first, then attach the file once the conversation is open. This is not a guaranteed fix; for anything urgent, paste the text or describe the file and try the upload again later.
notices.fix: Ready - goes out with the next planned release.
notices.statusPageGuidance: Show under Slack only. Web uploads are fine. The fix is ready and goes out with the next planned release.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks to upload, attach, send, read, or analyze a file, screenshot, image, or document in Slack, or reports that a Slack file-upload message got no reply or stalled.
notices.runnethGuidance: Acknowledge that Runneth cannot read file uploads on Slack right now, while web uploads are fine. If the user is in Slack, tell them the current advice is to start a new Slack conversation instead of continuing the existing thread, then attach the file once the conversation is open. Do not present this as a guaranteed fix. For urgent work, ask them to paste the relevant text or describe the file and try the upload again later. If the user asks when this is fixed, say the fix is ready and goes out with the next planned release.
notices.supportGuidance: Confirm the upload happened in Slack. Capture whether the Slack conversation was new or an existing thread, the approximate time, file type, and whether the message received no reply, timed out, or failed before sending.
